transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we discussed, the temporary support annex has two rooms — East and West — both of which can be made ready by tomorrow morning. We'll be placing an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk in those rooms. Before I sign off on room assignments and the required controls, I need to hear from facilities and signal. Please report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements you have so I can factor those into my approval. Let's start with facilities — what do you need?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a floor-load concern. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That cabinet cannot go in East Room — it exceeds the rating by 300 kilograms. West Room can support it. I should note the floor-load figures haven't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good catch, Major Alvarez. That's exactly the kind of thing I need before signing off. So the equipment-issue desk with its 1,100-kilogram cabinet must go in West Room — East Room can't support it. That would leave East Room for the medical-records desk, but before I lock that in, I need to hear from Signal. The medical-records desk involves protected records, so there may be network or certification requirements that affect which room it needs to be in. Signal, what are your requirements?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Understood, sir. I'll make sure the floor-load figures get added to the relocation worksheet today. I'll stand by for Signal's input — if there are any infrastructure requirements that affect room placement, facilities is ready to coordinate on whatever adjustments are needed for either room.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, the protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow — I received the booking confirmation this morning. However, that certification is not yet on the annex opening checklist, so we need to get it added. This means the medical-records desk needs to be in East Room, which aligns with Major Alvarez's floor-load requirement that puts the equipment-issue desk in West Room.
